transactions.citation: FY2025 AR p178 (cash-flow statement, FY2024 comparative column): 'Proceeds from disposal of assets/liabilities held for sale' EUR24,500k; 'Loss on disposal of assets/liabilities held for sale' EUR224k. Carrying value EUR24,698k and full deal narrative sourced from the FY2024 annual report (Note 2.3, p189/7273), since Il·lumina is absent from the FY2025 Statement of Portfolio (pp179-181), having been divested before FY2025 began.
transactions.notes: SAME deal_id as the FY2024 filing (ud1u:illumina:divestment:2024) per spec's cross-year-duplicate rule — this is the identical transaction (completed 31 Jan 2024, agreed via conditional SPA 22 Dec 2023), which the FY2025 AR only reports as a prior-period comparative in the cash-flow statement (proceeds EUR24,500k, loss EUR224k), without restating the EUR24,698k carrying value. reference_value/gain_loss_pct are carried over from the FY2024 AR (where the carrying value IS printed) rather than left null, since the underlying deal facts are unchanged and fully evidenced across the two reports together; a prior round of this FY2025 extraction incorrectly nulled gain_loss_pct/carrying_value by looking only at the FY2025 AR in isolation. No FY2025-native acquisitions or divestments occurred.
